course.title: Radio Astronomy
course.description: Covers radio emission mechanisms, antennas, receivers, interferometry, aperture synthesis, calibration, spectral line observations, pulsars, neutral hydrogen mapping, and radio survey analysis.

status.reviewStatus: Approved for review release; not yet approved for instructional use

cadence.rationale: Seven two-lecture units each build the physical/instrument model before the paired lab and problem set; cadence is documented in syllabus.html.

levels.level1: OpenStax §6.4, ALMA Basics, NRAO VLA navigation, ATNF catalogue definitions, and HI4PI paper/CDS release metadata and response values live-verified 2026-09-25.
levels.level2: Other published object and historical survey parameters not re-verified; see reference-log.md for spot-check requirements.
levels.level3: Compact CSV exercise tables and all computed figures are synthetic/instructor-provided teaching records.
